name: Kikou Shoujo Tai Girls Force
original_name: 機甲少女隊ガールズフォース
source:
Mankind is attacked by aggressors from outer space. Through the godlike devotion of the female emperor, the already desperate human race gains the courage to squeeze the last strength. The research of revolutionary weapons allows to revert the situation. The invaders retreat leaving their destructive weapons all over the universe. This is a story about a military academy where future protectors of the galaxy are being brought up.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
人类遭到来自外太空的侵略者攻击。在女皇近乎神圣的奉献精神鼓舞下，已陷入绝境的人类鼓起勇气，挤出最后的力量。革命性武器的研发令战局逆转，侵略者撤退，却把破坏性兵器遗留在宇宙各处。这是一个关于军事学院的故事，未来的银河守护者们正在那里成长。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
